horn.question: Is HORN_ACTIVATE momentary/policy-bounded, or can it establish a persistent active state requiring a user-level False write?

differential_lock.question: Does the product expose partial diff-lock engagement as a user voice control, or is 0..100 a lower-level actuator range?

source_integrity.human_decision_source: User-provided SYS-014 Full Registry Human Approval Apply & Consistency Freeze instruction

current_definition.coverage: Only 0% and 100% semantic endpoints are represented as lock/unlock; intermediate engagement has no Intent.

proposed_definition.area_semantics: FRONT / REAR / ALL; optional only if policy permits ALL as default

vss_evidence.description: Front Diff Lock engagement. 0% = Diff lock fully disengaged. 100% = Diff lock fully engaged.
Rear Diff Lock engagement. 0% = Diff lock fully disengaged. 100% = Diff lock fully engaged.

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: 两个 VSS actuator 都是 0..100% 的连续 Engagement 写入量；现有 LOCK/UNLOCK 只能表达全结合与全分离端点。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 新增 SET_ENGAGEMENT 能覆盖用户明确请求的中间结合度，同时保留 LOCK/UNLOCK 的离散安全语义；但量产车辆是否允许语音设置中间结合度必须由人审确认。

natural_language_examples.text: 把前差速锁结合度设到50%

affects_other_intents.boundary: 0/100 endpoints remain distinct commands; intermediate percentage uses SET_ENGAGEMENT.

change_items.review_focus: Confirm that user-level voice control of partial differential-lock engagement is a supported product requirement, not merely a low-level actuator capability.
change_items.human_comment: 不新增 DIFFERENTIAL_SET_ENGAGEMENT：项目不把差速锁 0~100% 中间结合度作为普通用户级语音控制能力；保留 DIFFERENTIAL_LOCK / DIFFERENTIAL_UNLOCK。

current_definition.unresolved_lifecycle: Registry does not state whether HORN_ACTIVATE is momentary/pulsed or establishes a persistent active state.

proposed_definition.approval_condition: Approve only if HORN_ACTIVATE can leave the actuator active beyond an instantaneous/policy-bounded pulse and False is an exposed user command.
proposed_definition.rejection_condition: Reject if HORN_ACTIVATE is strictly momentary and release/timeout is internal execution behavior.

vss_evidence.description: Horn active or inactive. True = Active. False = Inactive.

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: VSS 明示 IsActive=True/False，但仅凭可写 Boolean 不能证明 False 是独立语音目的；当前 Registry 也没有定义 HORN_ACTIVATE 的持续时间和释放语义。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 若系统允许持续鸣笛，‘停止鸣笛’是明确的 False write；若鸣笛始终是瞬时脉冲，则停止由执行生命周期完成，不应新增 Intent。该项必须人工裁决，不能按对称性自动新增。

natural_language_examples.representation_if_rejected: No standalone Intent; execution layer releases/times out HORN_ACTIVATE.

affects_other_intents.boundary: Do not reinterpret negated activation (‘不要鸣笛’) as deactivation; it remains HORN_ACTIVATE + NEGATION.

change_items.review_focus: Decide whether HORN_ACTIVATE is momentary or persistent. This decision controls whether HORN_DEACTIVATE exists.
change_items.human_comment: 不新增 HORN_DEACTIVATE：HORN_ACTIVATE 按瞬时/有界动作处理，停止由执行生命周期释放或超时完成；不得按 Boolean 对称强行扩展。

proposed_definition.note: BEAM is the VSS canonical enum. ‘ON’ may remain a lexical alias only; it must not be added as a source enum.

vss_evidence.description: Status of the vehicle main light switch.

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: 唯一批准来源 LightSwitch 没有 ON 枚举，也没有独立主灯开关 Boolean；HEADLIGHT_ON 因此缺少一对一 VSS write semantic。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 将通用‘打开主灯/大灯’规范化到 HEADLIGHT_SET_MODE + MODE=BEAM，保持一个枚举 actuator 对应一个参数化 Intent。

affects_other_intents.reason: These have independent VSS actuator paths.

change_items.human_comment: 删除独立 HEADLIGHT_ON；明确主灯开关语义下，‘打开主灯/大灯’统一为 HEADLIGHT_SET_MODE + MODE=BEAM。ON 仅是受限词法别名。

vss_evidence.description: Status of the vehicle main light switch.

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: OFF 是 LightSwitch 的明确枚举值，不是独立 actuator；HEADLIGHT_OFF 与 HEADLIGHT_SET_MODE(MODE=OFF) 表达同一 VSS write。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 合并后避免同一 source/action/target/parameter contract 的双重标签，并保留 OFF 的明确安全语义。

affects_other_intents.reason: Independent beam/fog actuator writes remain separate.

change_items.human_comment: 删除独立 HEADLIGHT_OFF；‘关闭主灯/大灯’统一为 HEADLIGHT_SET_MODE + MODE=OFF。

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: 当前 MODE 仅列 P/R/N/D，遗漏 VSS 描述中的明确正整数前进挡和负整数倒挡；把‘2挡’标为普通 VALUE 又会丢失离散挡位语义。
change_items.why_proposed_change: GEAR_SET 保持一个 Intent，MODE 必填；P/R/N/D 与具体整数挡都是离散目标模式。VALUE 不用于挡位目标，避免把数值挡误作连续量。
change_items.review_focus: Approve the typed, vehicle-validated MODE domain and decide the product-level alias rule for R.
change_items.human_comment: GEAR_SET 保持 MODE 必填、NEGATION 可选且 VALUE 不用于目标挡位。P/N/D、FORWARD_GEAR_N、REVERSE_GEAR_N 为 canonical 类别；R挡/倒挡仅作词法识别，物理 gear code 由 VehicleCapabilityMapping 做车型级映射与校验，通用 Registry 禁止写死 R -> REVERSE_GEAR_1。

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: 当前合同把 VALUE 设为必填、MODE 仅可选，却又把 LEVEL_1..4 塞入 VALUE enum；它混淆米制距离与离散间隔等级，并无 VSS 依据地固定为四级。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 同一 CRUISE_SET_GAP Intent 保留两种互斥主表达：米制/相对变化走 VALUE，明确等级走 MODE。自然语言‘远一点’不是模式目标，应为相对 VALUE。
change_items.human_comment: CRUISE_SET_GAP 采用 VALUE XOR MODE；VALUE 表达米制或远/近相对量，MODE 表达 LEVEL_N。两者仅在确定性一致时允许共同出现。

vss_evidence.description: Status of the vehicle main light switch.

change_items.why_current_registry_is_wrong: 当前 HEADLIGHT mode_contract 遗漏 LightSwitch 明示的 OFF；同时独立 HEADLIGHT_ON/OFF 造成同一枚举 source 的标签分裂。
change_items.why_proposed_change: 采用完整、逐字来自 VSS 的五值 mode contract；ON 仅作为 BEAM 的受限词法别名，不把独立近光/远光/雾灯 actuator 吞入主灯模式。

representation.note: Only when main-switch reference is unambiguous.

change_items.human_comment: HEADLIGHT_SET_MODE 的 MODE 必填，canonical 五值为 OFF/POSITION/DAYTIME_RUNNING_LIGHTS/AUTO/BEAM；ON 仅是明确主灯开关语义下 BEAM 的受限别名，LOW/HIGH/FOG intents 保持独立。
